Title: Self-service password reset from the Windows 10 sign in for hybrid domain joined devices is now available

Body.Content:
Windows 10 devices that are domain-joined to both on-premises AD and cloud Azure AD allow user self-service password reset from the sign in screen.  This can be enabled through a device configuration policy in Microsoft Intune or by configuring a registry key.

Learn more
